descriptors.definition: SQC 1 establishes firm-wide quality control systems and policies applicable to all assurance and related services engagements. In contrast, SA 220 addresses specific quality control procedures implemented by engagement teams for individual audit engagements only.
nearby_distinctions: SQC 1 governs the entire practice unit while SA 220 focuses exclusively on individual audit execution and engagement team responsibilities.

descriptors.concept_name: Mechanisms for Review of Quality Control
descriptors.definition: Regulatory and professional bodies oversee and examine the quality of professional services provided by members and practice units. These mechanisms employ structured reviews to ensure compliance with technical, professional, and ethical standards.
inclusion: Monitoring of accounting and auditing standards compliance
exclusion: Internal firm self-evaluations without statutory backing
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between internal quality control systems and external statutory oversight bodies such as QRB and NFRA.

descriptors.definition: A board constituted by the ICAI Council to examine and review the systems and procedures of practice units. Its primary objective is ensuring member compliance with technical, professional, and ethical standards through structured assignment records evaluation.
exclusion: Direct investigation of listed company audits governed by NFRA
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on practice units and assurance engagements under ICAI oversight rather than centralized government-appointed quality boards.

descriptors.definition: A body established by the Central Government to review the quality of services provided by ICAI members using a risk-based approach. It guides members on regulatory adherence and covers entities outside the specific jurisdiction of the NFRA.
inclusion: Review of audit services for non-NFRA entities
exclusion: Oversight of listed companies and banking entities under NFRA purview
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on entities outside Rule 3 NFRA rules, differing from NFRA's mandated jurisdiction over listed and financial institutions.

descriptors.definition: A regulatory authority constituted under the Companies Act to monitor and enforce accounting and auditing standards. It oversees audit quality and investigates auditors of specific major classes of companies such as listed entities, banks, and insurance firms.
inclusion: Investigation of auditors for specified companies
Oversight of listed company audit quality
exclusion: General peer reviews of smaller practice units handled by ICAI
Quality reviews for entities outside Rule 3 criteria
nearby_distinctions: Operates with statutory enforcement and investigative powers over specific high-impact companies, unlike standard ICAI peer review mechanisms.
